cases.explain: «нечестивые замыслы» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief,

cases.explain: «дурной женщины» — after the preposition «от», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.

cases.explain: «горячим углям» — after the preposition «по», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?
